domain_claim: The dispatch-sandbox probe wrapper captures a byte-stable BdVersion + BdBinaryPath pair from `bd version` across repeated probes within the same femdation child invocation; a probe digest mismatch is rejected (anti-invariant) rather than silently re-rendered.
expected_evidence: Test passes for 64 cases (test result: ok); the harness probes `bd version` and `which bd` repeatedly; the anti-invariant asserts that any probe digest mismatch (sha256(input_capture) != sha256(replay_capture)) fails the test case instead of being silently re-rendered into a normalized stable shape.

domain_claim: `SchemaErrorClass::parse(raw)` is a closed-grammar parser over bd stderr strings; hostile-crafted inputs (empty, multi-line, unicode, truncation, mixed-case identifier, malformed port literal) reject without panic and route to `SchemaErrorClass::Unclassified { raw_error }`. Fuzz oracle: parse(raw) → render → re-parse(input) is idempotent for valid classes; for invalid inputs, parse returns Unclassified without invoking round-trip render.
expected_evidence: cargo-fuzz reports no diagnostic across the runtime; the round-trip oracle rejects all hostile corpus entries (no panic, no round-trip render for Unclassified); negative verification: invalid input class is mapped to SchemaErrorClass::Unclassified and never returns NoSuchColumn/NoSuchTable/NoSuchMigration.
assumptions: bd stderr strings are bounded at 4096 bytes

domain_claim: `BeadsConfig::load(path)` and `BeadsMetadata::load(path)` are closed-key parsers; a fuzz corpus with `BeadsMetadata` carrying a `dolt_server_port` key OR `BeadsConfig` carrying a `dolt_database` key OR a precedence-inverted BEADS_DOLT_* override on the wrong layer MUST be rejected. The differential fuzz oracle: parse the corrupted input → check the parser rejects → reload the original `.beads/` and confirm round-trip equivalence.
expected_evidence: cargo-fuzz reports no diagnostic across the runtime; the differential fuzz oracle rejects every corpus entry that violates BEADS_DOLT_* precedence order or places a forbidden key on the wrong layer; the post-repair round-trip check confirms cargo-deny-style regression corpus is rejected (no panic, no silent normalization).
assumptions: BeadsConfig and BeadsMetadata are bounded at 4096 bytes per file

domain_claim: `AddSchemaMigration::statement` parser rejects every `ALTER TABLE … DROP COLUMN depends_on_id` and every `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN depends_on_id … <plain>` (i.e. not STORED/COMMENTED) statement and emits `AddSchemaMigrationStatementInvalid`; the migration chain 0041-0042 is intentionally irreversible and is rejected at parse time. Round-trip oracle: valid STORED/COMMENTED statements parse → render → re-parse identical; plain-column statements never round-trip.
expected_evidence: cargo-fuzz reports no diagnostic across the runtime; the round-trip oracle rejects every corpus entry that targets `depends_on_id` outside a STORED/COMMENTED context as `AddSchemaMigrationStatementInvalid`; negative verification: no corpus entry that re-declares `depends_on_id` as plain succeeds the round-trip or survives normalization.
assumptions: AddSchemaMigration statements are bounded at 4096 bytes

domain_claim: Post-repair verification re-runs `bd dolt status`, `bd dolt test`, `bd info`, `bd migrate`, `bd sql "SHOW COLUMNS FROM dependencies"`, `bash scripts/check-beads-server-mode.sh`, and `bd supersede vb-qryp7 --with vb-t0iw9`; every command exits 0 within documented model bounds and the supersede smoke returns stdout line 1 exactly matching `Marked vb-qryp7 as superseded by vb-t0iw9 (closed)`. Anti-invariant: an exit code != 0 OR a missing supersede-marked line flips the outcome to VerificationFailed (not silently re-run).
expected_evidence: Test passes for 16 cases (test result: ok); strategy executes each verification command once per property case; the anti-invariant asserts that any non-zero exit code or any missing `Marked vb-qryp7 as superseded by vb-t0iw9 (closed)` line flips the case to VerificationFailed rather than re-running; a should_fail assertion is paired for the bad-config corpus.
assumptions: live shared Dolt server at 127.0.0.1:45645 reachable from the isolated workspace
